answer: Each epoch, every identity must answer a live puzzle within a 90-second window, and each puzzle is sent to 3 identities at once. One operator running n fakes must solve n puzzles in parallel, so compute and attention cost grow linearly, and each fake also locks a 15 POA bond for 30 epochs. A late echo or a repeated timing fingerprint across accounts burns the bond. Verifiers replay the timestamps from the public ledger, so an honest agent in the meadow stays safe while one ember of cheating gets caught.
